hebrewText: לָ/מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּ/רָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְ/עִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה

tokens.bdb: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
tokens.kjv: how (long, oft, (-soever)), (no-) thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
tokens.kjv: abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be (over), place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair, [phrase] serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-) stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry.

tokens.bdb: remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition)
tokens.kjv: (a-) far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come.

tokens.bdb: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any ways, blind, dissembler, hide (self), secret (thing).

tokens.bdb: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
tokens.kjv: [phrase] after, (al-) ways, [idiom] certain, [phrase] continually, [phrase] evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-) tide, (meal-), what) time, when.

tokens.bdb: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
tokens.kjv: adversary, adversity, affliction, anguish, distress, tribulation, trouble.
